message.content:
This is a part of an LED roadway warning light for crosswalks. The relevant candidates are:

- 8530.80 (electrical signaling, safety or traffic control equipment for roads), with parts under 8530.90.
- 9405.42 (LED lighting fittings), with parts under 9405.99.

The device is a signaling device that warns motorists of a pedestrian, so it is traffic signaling equipment under 8530.80. The stainless steel housing is a part of that equipment, so 8530.90 applies.

The HTSUS breakdown under 8530.90 is:

- 8530.90.00: Parts
- 8530.90.0000 is the 10-digit statistical form.

CBP ruling (NY N-series) for a similar LightStar housing: I recall the classification as 8530.90.0000, parts of electrical signaling equipment.

{"hts_code": "8530.90.0000", "reason": "The stainless steel housing is a part of electrical traffic signaling equipment, a roadway pedestrian crosswalk warning light, so it falls under heading 8530 as a part (8530.90)."}
